svg.text: Feed the rails from the ESP32, then wire each trimpot the same way
Each trimpot goes in 3 columns, legs in row c. In the same 3 columns:
• red: left column (row a) → + rail • blue: right column (row a) → − rail • teal: middle column (row e) → ESP32 pin
Red and blue are short male-male wires. Teal and the two rail feeds are male-female (female end on the ESP32 pin).
If your trimpot's legs are in a triangle, just make sure each leg lands in a different column. Which outer leg goes to + doesn't matter.
